title: Page header
summary: The head of a work page of an app: path, heading, favourite star, install mark, actions (the main one last) and views (tabs); sticky on request. An app with a side menu has no top bar, so this is the page's head (C161).

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

heading.description: The page heading, drawn as the fourth heading step (20/24): a work page of an app titles itself there, an exception to C21's h1 at step 6 (owner decision C161 (2)); a page of a site keeps its own h1

count.description: How many records the page holds, as the host writes it (448, ~1 200), for a page without a table footer (a folder, a settings section); a list page shows no count here, its table footer gives the total (owner decision C161 (6)). Empty draws no count

level.description: install marks a page shared by every site

expressive.description: The decorative level (owner decision C91, level 2): a tinted head, primary tone 50 at 16 (dark 24) fading down to nothing, in a padded rounded field; a head narrower than 30rem (the g5 step) stays plain. Off by default; data-sf-style="expressive" on the root or a container turns it on for every head under it, data-sf-style="strict" turns it off again.

overflow.description: What the actions do when they do not fit their line (owner decision C155 (7), C161 (4)): more (the default) keeps one row and puts what does not fit under ⋯ «Ещё» at its end -- from the end, by an action's priority attribute where the page gives one (1 the most important; pin never leaves), the main (filled) action and a pressed toggle never; wrap lets the row wrap onto further rows of its own (OV-2).

sticky.description: The header stays at the top of the work area that scrolls it (the nearest box that scrolls, else the window), a half step of room above and below its line; flat while the area is at its top, it takes the raised place of C20 and folds the path away while content runs under it (host state data-scrolled). Off by default (owner decision C161 (7))

star.description: Absent draws no star; false (or off) and true (or on) draw it in that state

sf-header-page-toggle.summary: The person pressed the star: the request to make the page a favourite (on) or not; a host that answers itself cancels it and writes star

sf-page-header-star.summary: The person pressed the star. Cancelable: a host that waits for its own answer cancels it and sets star itself.

keyboard: Tab reaches the star and the actions
Enter or Space toggles the star
accessibility.focus: The star is a native button in sf-icon-button with a label that says what pressing it does, and so its state; it carries no aria-pressed (rule C12).

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-header-page at the top of every work page of an app (admin, SIMAI Pro, mail): an app with a side menu has no top bar, so this header states the page's path, heading, favourite, actions and views; a site uses sf-header-site instead.
do_not: Do not keep favourites in the component; answer sf-header-page-toggle from the host
Do not put a list's total in the header; the table footer gives it (C161 (6))
Do not style the heading yourself; it is the fourth heading step
Do not draw a head of your own above a work page or place tabs under the header yourself; use the start and tabs slots
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-header-page heading="Каталог решений" star="off"><sf-breadcrumbs slot="path" items='[{"label":"Администрирование","href":"/admin/"},{"label":"Данные","href":"/admin/data/"}]'></sf-breadcrumbs><sf-button slot="actions" appearance="outline" icon-start="download" text="Экспорт"></sf-button><sf-button slot="actions" icon-start="add" text="Создать"></sf-button></sf-header-page>
